title: Does shade explain dry soil?
question: Could shade and irrigation timing explain the south plot?
falsifier: If equally irrigated shaded and exposed sensors stay equally dry, reject the shade hypothesis.
dissent: The path observation may not describe the plot itself.
assumptions: The observation dates and rainfall exposure are comparable.

pages.text:
# Water observations
The south plot stayed dry after rain.
No temperature was recorded.

# Site observations
The south path has no shade at noon.
The north path was closed.

excerpts.quote: The south plot stayed dry after rain.
excerpts.observation: Dry soil after rain raises a possible exposure question.
excerpts.challenge: Check the actual rainfall and irrigation record.

excerpts.observation: Nearby shade observations suggest a test, not a causal conclusion.
